patch.title: Under the Flyover
patch.logline: At night beneath a Hyderabad flyover, a boy squats on a strip of soil, absorbed in a phone, while the traffic turns around him.
patch.treatment: Night beneath a concrete flyover. Now and then a vehicle swings through the U-turn, its headlights sliding across the pillars. On a raised planting bed of bare soil at the base of a pillar, a few bags, covers and cooking utensils mark where someone stays; there is no tent. A boy squats on the soil in dirty, torn clothes, bent over a smartphone, scrolling short videos, its glow on his face against the orange streetlight. The film watches without explaining: engines echoing under the deck, the thin sound of the reels, the small movement of his thumb. We don't learn who he is or how he came to be here. The last shot stays close on his absorbed face as headlights keep passing behind him, and leaves the contrast to the audience.
observed: A homeless child squatting beneath a flyover in Hyderabad.
The child wore dirty, torn clothes.
He was deeply absorbed in scrolling reels on a smartphone.
The place was at a U-turn, on a raised planting bed containing soil.
A few bags, covers and basic cooking utensils were there; not a tent.
The observer found the contrast disturbing (the film's starting point; not shown on screen).
creative_additions: The boy is fictional: his age (about 10), build, hair and clothing colours are invented.

Night (a creative choice, not confirmed as observed); lighting mood from the supplied AI-generated image: warm sodium streetlight glancing off concrete pillars and asphalt, deep shadow under the flyover, cool blue-black sky.
The phone's cold screen glow on his face.
Occasional vehicles turning, headlights sweeping the pillars; sound design without music.
Camera: a static wide, a slow push-in, a static close-up; shot order and durations.
Gestures: elbows on knees, thumb flicking up the screen; the phone is old, in a scuffed case.
guardrails: Fictional child; not based on, and not resembling, any identifiable real child.
No backstory: nothing about who he is, why he is there, or where his family is.
No causal claim: the film doesn't suggest the phone or scrolling caused his poverty, or the reverse.
Dignity: no staged squalor beyond what was observed, no exaggerated dirt or distress, no begging or pleading to camera.
No real apps, brands, logos, creators or readable text on the phone or in the surroundings.
Observational: no slow motion and no music telling the audience what to feel.
open_questions: Location reference: the supplied image's layout (tarp shelter, concrete kerb, extra belongings, readable signs, no U-turn) doesn't match the brief; choose the final reference before any video.
Night is a creative choice unless you confirm it was observed.

assets.name: Boy (fictional)
assets.description: Fictional Indian boy about 10, thin, short untidy black hair, barefoot, faded torn dusty T-shirt and shorts.
assets.image_prompt: Full-body character reference photo of a fictional Indian boy about 10 years old, thin build, short untidy black hair, barefoot, wearing a faded, torn and dusty grey T-shirt and dark blue shorts. Standing straight and facing the camera, arms relaxed, calm neutral expression. Photographed at night against a plain dark background under warm sodium-orange streetlight from one side, with soft fill so his face and clothes stay clearly readable; photorealistic, natural skin texture, sharp focus. Dignified, not posed for pity. No text, no logos, no other people. Portrait 2:3.

assets.name: Flyover (night)
assets.description: Mood and night-lighting reference only (layout not approved for video): concrete flyover pillars under warm sodium streetlight, deep shadow beneath the deck, blue-black sky.

shots.title: The U-turn
shots.intention: Establish the place at night, and how small he is in it.
shots.action: At night beneath the flyover, an occasional vehicle turns through the U-turn, headlights sweeping the pillars. On the raised planting bed of soil at the base of a pillar, a few bags, covers and cooking utensils sit near @boy, who squats with his head bent over an old smartphone, its screen glowing.
shots.audio: An occasional vehicle turning, engines echoing under the flyover, a distant horn; no music.

shots.title: Absorbed
shots.intention: His absorption, set against the city moving past.
shots.action: @boy squats on the soil, elbows on knees, thumb flicking up the screen of an old smartphone in a scuffed case; its cold glow lights his face against the orange streetlight; headlights pass behind him, softly out of focus.
shots.audio: Engines under the flyover, quieter; the phone's thin reel audio becomes audible; no music.

shots.title: The screen
shots.intention: Stay with him; leave the contrast to the audience.
shots.action: Close on @boy's absorbed face, lit by the phone's shifting screen glow; he keeps scrolling as headlights pass, out of focus, behind him.
shots.audio: The phone's reel audio, close and thin, over distant traffic; a horn far away; no music.
